description_for_human: Publishes the IRE weekly status report to the SharePoint 'weeklies' library and emails the link.
description_for_model: Use this to publish a weekly status report the agent has drafted. Provide ww, author, and the progress, blockers, and next_week bullet arrays. The action renders a Word document, uploads it to the SharePoint weeklies library, optionally emails it, and returns a sharepoint_url. Only state that the weekly is published if a sharepoint_url is returned.

functions.name: publishWeekly
functions.description: Render the weekly .docx, upload it to the SharePoint weeklies library, and optionally email the link.

_notes: For production, replace the ApiKeyPluginVault auth with OAuthPluginVault (Microsoft Entra ID) so calls run as the signed-in user and inherit SharePoint permissions. This manifest is the 'action' half of a declarative agent; reference it from the agent's declarativeAgent.json under 'actions'.
